en: Theragāthā 2.19 Dukanipāta, Second Chapter The Elder’s Verses 2.19 Second Chapter, Second Section: The Pairs (Duka-nipāta) I am free from fear, my mind is well-composed, My conduct is pure, and I dwell in solitude; Having abandoned all attachments, I am free from craving— Thus do I live, O King, as one who has attained peace.
The Verses of the Elder Nanda:
through one skilled in means, I—
"By practicing with wise discernment, one should uproot the mind from existence, as taught by the Buddha, the Kinsman of the Sun."
